verdict.rationale: Groq documents a first-party Batch API for submitting thousands of requests as one asynchronous batch. It offers 50% lower cost, no impact on standard rate limits, and a 24-hour to 7-day processing window. Flex processing adds a high-throughput tier with 10x higher rate limits for paid customers. missing for 10: details on batch file format, job status/cancellation and result retrieval, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch usage.
